en: Writing...?

Yeah! Like someone try to hide writing
in grass! Weird, right!?
Hmmmm... Atua says it's just graffiti.

Nyahahahaha! Now we don't gotta worry
about it anymore!
Atua? That's even more suspicious...

Oh? Are you saying Atua is suspicious?
How sad.
That's none of your business.

What's up with you guys?
Are you still talking about that graffiti?

Whatever...I brought Shuichi, so let's
start breakfast already.

<CLT=cltMIND>I quickly realized that everyone
was staring at me.
Ah...
Nyeh?

<CLT=cltMIND>As I expected, they were looking
at me with surprise on their faces.
Good morning...
Ah... Good morning...
Oh, Shuichi... Um...

You finally got rid of that emo hat!
Is this cuz Kaede died or whatever?

Quiet, you male!
Learn some manners, why don't you!?

Oh, huh, you're not wearing your hat.
I didn't even notice.

And you could stand to learn some
manners too, you insensitive jerk!

N-No, I just...felt like it was
getting in the way is all.

You don't have to stare... I just took off my
hat, it's not a big deal...
You are right. My apologies.

I like it. I think you look more handsome
with your hat off.
Ah...thank you.
Keh, how nice for you.

Unlike Plain Jane over here, who turns
invisible as soon as her glasses come off.

I am plain...but it's the other way around.
Taking off my glasses reveals my true form.

Hmhmhm...didn't you know? Those who see 
my true form pay a terrible price.

Anyway, don't be late anymore, Shuichi. We 
already decided we're eating breakfast together.
...You decided that on your own.
Yes, yes. I prepared breakfast for everyone.
Really? You did?
Indeed. It was no trouble at all.

I have prepared an Italian omelet, buttermilk
pancakes, smoked salmon galette...

And for those who prefer Japanese cuisine,
I have prepared rice balls and miso soup.
Kirumi, be my mom!
Gonta want you to be his mom, too!
...What are you two even saying?

Oh, yeah! I'll show you guys something
really neat!

Look, look! When Himiko eats, she makes the
cutest face!
Awww! She's like a small animal!
Stop it...you're making it hard for me to eat.

<CLT=cltMIND>We chatted casually as we began
eating the food Kirumi brought out.

Gonta not mean to flatter, but...all this food
so yummy!

Mmm, it's so delicious, it makes me want 
to cut off my tongue.

Mm-hm... The rice balls aren't just ordinary
ol' rice balls, either!

The outside is packed tightly so it won't
fall apart, but the inside is nice and soft!

And cuz the rice wasn't crushed, you can taste
every sweet, sticky grain, even when it's cold!

Hey, do you have some sort of god tongue 
or something?

By not crushing the rice, air is able to flow
between each individual grain.

The triangle shape itself is less important than
maintaining a loose grip as you form the shape.

You will find it much easier if you imagine
yourself gripping it with your entire body.

Nyeeeh...I can't make rice balls. I can't even
tell the difference between rice and termites.
...How have you survived this long?

Hm? What's wrong, Kee-boy?
You're not eating—

Oh, yeah! I totally forgot you can't eat!
Y'know, cuz you're a robot!

Hey now, don't look so down.
I'll bring you a broken TV later.
I don't want that... I'm not a waste receptacle.

Nyahahaha! Keebo and Kokichi seem to
be getting along swimmingly.

<CLT=cltMIND>We were having a normal conversation...
as if nothing had happened.

<CLT=cltMIND>But we all knew it wasn't really normal.
It was <CLT=cltSTRONG>forced conversation<CLT=cltMIND>.

<CLT=cltMIND>But that's to be expected.
That incident just happened yesterday, after all.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's forcing themselves...
That's why...

<CLT=cltMIND>This kind of <CLT=cltSTRONG>forced normalcy<CLT=cltMIND>
is just making us remember what happened...

Hm? What's the matter, Shuichi? If you're 
not gonna eat this, I'll just help myself!
Ah, sorry. Hey, I was gonna eat that!

<CLT=cltMIND>I pushed those unnecessary thoughts out of
my head and shoveled food in my mouth.

By the way, that thing Gonta talked about 
earlier...are we going to go check it out?

Keh! Quit fussin' over some lousy graffiti and
worry about your shitty future instead!
Huh? Graffiti?
Oh, Gonta find it this morning...
On concrete, hidden in grass...
Words "horse a" written there.
Huh... What do you think it means?

Well...its meaning is entirely shrouded 
in mystery.

Not even the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Anthropologist<CLT=cltNORMAL> knows...
I thought it was some anthropology thing.

Well, how about it, Shuichi? Let's hear the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Detective<CLT=cltNORMAL>'s opinion.
Huh? Ah...

I...don't know?
I don't know either.

Gonta, I'm surprised you were able to find
that graffiti hidden in the grass.
Do you channel the divine, too?
Oh... That cuz of tiny bugs.

Bugs...? I thought vermin were nowhere to be
seen in this academy.
Yeah, Gonta think that before, but...

When out walking in courtyard, Gonta think
he see tiny bug.

But...bug so tiny, even Gonta no could see it.
And Gonta have 20/0.625 eyesight.

So maybe Gonta just make mistake.
But Gonta think...
No, maybe Gonta just see things...

Gah! Just make up your mind already,
you degenerate!

So, you found that message while you were
out chasing some bug?

Wooow, Gonta! You did it! I knew I could rely
on you since the moment we met!
What? Really?
...Yep! So you should work for me!
Okay!

What? You're going to agree to it
just like that?

Be careful, Gonta.
That guy's a real liar.
What? Really?
Haha, no way.
Good. Then Gonta have no reason to worry.
Will you believe just anyone!?

Nee-heehee... Gonta, you're so gullible.
Y'know, if you keep being this gullible...

You'll be <CLT=cltSTRONG>killed<CLT=cltNORMAL> before you know it.
Understand?

<CLT=cltMIND>The moment Kokichi said <CLT=cltSTRONG>that word<CLT=cltMIND>,
the warm and casual mood shattered.

What's wrong, everyone? Is there a problem
with Kokichi's advice?

Oh, Kokichi... You no should say thing like
that, even as joke.

Hm? Say what, "<CLT=cltSTRONG>kill<CLT=cltNORMAL>"?
Has the K-word been banned?
S-Sorry...I didn't know.

But that's not very reasonable, is it?
Not when the killing game is still happening.

H-How can you be so insensitive...?
Especially after what happened yesterday!

This is why I hate degenerate males! They're
about as considerate as amoebas!

Don't complain if some scary guy yells
"What color is your blood!?" at you!

...It's that kinda talk that lets Monokuma play
you all like fiddles.
What...?

Oh, did you hear that? Don't mind me—I was
just talking to myself.

Helloooo! Looks like you guys are having a
good time. Let me join in.

Yeah! They're having a jolly good time
ganging up on me!
Isn't that your fault?
...Hm? Ganging up?

No bullying! Bullying is not cool! Bullying
is the worst!

Personally, I think bullying is cuz of lousy
parenting.

It's all the parents' fault! They should do
a better job raising their kids!
Why are you even here?

Ahh...I figured I'd give you guys a <CLT=cltSTRONG>prize<CLT=cltNORMAL> for
surviving the class trial.
A prize...?
R-Rise and shine, ursine...
U-Um... The reward, right?

We...brought it, yep. So...I-I'll just give it to
you, then...

Hmm? My kids seem a little under the weather.
Well, even so, they're still freakin' adorable.
Are...you being bullied?
Gah!
Th-That's...um...

I knew it.
I understand...from experience.

F-From experience...? Himiko, were you a victim
of bullying in the past!?

Is that why your heart is broken and you can't
express real emotions anymore!?

Gaaahhh! Use your magic to turn the human
rejects who bullied you into misshapen wretches!

I don't use my magic for stuff like that.
And don't just make up my backstory.

Huh? Hold on, the Monokubs...bully each
other?

N-No way! The Monokubs should always
get along!

Hey, you kids play nice together, right!?
I'm not a lousy parent, am I!?

Even if you do bully each other real bad, it's
not cuz I'm a bad dad, right!?
WE-ALL...GET-ALONG. ALWAYS.
Hm? Oh, yes...we do...

See? My children are good kids. They would
never bully each other.

The bullying will never stop...
because of people like you.

Well, I think the threatening vibe we
Monokubs give off is perfect.

Cuz we're a team of scary badasses who
are gonna drag you down to hell!
Ah-hahahaha! Such adorable little badasses!

...Anyway, we're gonna hand out the rewards
youse all have been waitin' for.

Listen up! Cuz we got these here <CLT=cltSTRONG>fabulous,
nonsensical prizes<CLT=cltNORMAL> for youse!

A <CLT=cltSTRONG>Dragon Gem<CLT=cltNORMAL>, an <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ocarina<CLT=cltNORMAL>, an <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ancient Passport<CLT=cltNORMAL>,
and a <CLT=cltSTRONG>Hexagonal Crank from some zombie game<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
These prizes all come in a bundle!

Wow! What a bunch of random junk!
Bravo, bravo!

Yayyyyy! I-I don't get why these are prizes,
but aren't they lovely anyway!?

What's all this crap?
What are we supposed to do with this?

Honestly, I'm not sure. Maybe there's a way to
use them without knowing what they're for?

Who cares? Just put your best foot forward.
It's easier to move forward than backward.
How nice.
Don't get inspired by him, Gonta.

Anyway, that's the situation so just do your
best however you please!
LET'S-GO.

You're gonna get payback for all the bullying
by attacking us in our secret weak point!

Secret weak point?
You mean...the nape of our necks!?
N-Not that! Anything but that!

Wait, so the nape of your necks 
is your weak point?

I...WOULD-NEVER-DO-THAT.
I-JUST...WANT-TO-GET-ALONG.
...What? Get along? Really?

Don't let 'im fool ya!
He killed Monokid, remember!?

Hmmm... Seeing that robot-looking one get
left out makes me think of Keebo...
Am I really excluded!?
So...what should we do with this junk?

Maybe we need to use these on those 
mysterious things all over the campus?
And what'll happen when we do?
Umm...I'm not sure.

Well, we'll know once we try.
I'll take the junk, then.
No, let's leave this to Shuichi.
What? Me?

You're the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Detective<CLT=cltNORMAL>, yeah? You 
should be good at weirdo puzzles like this.
So I'm gonna leave it to you!
Okay...I'll try.
Maaan... Whatevs, I guess that's fine.

<CLT=cltMIND>So, I need to go around the academy and figure
out what these <CLT=cltSTRONG>mysterious objects<CLT=cltMIND> are for.
<CLT=cltMIND>Alright...let's get going.
Let's look around!
Do whatever you want.
Gonta hope we find some bugs!
Let's go exploring!
Kehehe...I find myself intrigued by that junk...
As I've said before, I am not junk.

I hope we find something useful. We must be
vigilant against an adversary like Monokuma.
Nyeh...I'll let you guys handle it...
Later.
Let's go already!

You probably use them on those 
mysterious objects, just like in games.
Atua is watching over you, Shuichi!
That trash is perfect for ya!
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's so clunky...
I wonder if that's just what Monokuma likes.
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"Dining Hall Rules"

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"You may eat any food you
find in the dining hall."

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"Please take responsibility for all utensils and
dishes used and clean up after yourself."

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"The dining hall will be locked
during nighttime."
